2034-3129-5220-6961-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-3129-5220-6961-8347.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Sela triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7841.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Darksteel Angel
When Darksteel Angel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

225-2645-3257-3430.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-2645-3257-3430.description:
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Rakdos Carnarium
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2105-4742-5778-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1308-3129-5478-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
1308-3129-5478-6441-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

7282-7340-7908.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five Halflings.
7282-7340-7908.description:
Activate The Notary Hobbits by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping The Notary Hobbits.
Repeat.

301-6602-7860.description:
Activate Mogg Raider by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Tromell.
Resolve the Mogg Raider ability.
Repeat.

2928-3558-3661-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
2928-3558-3661-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1987-2020-3277.easyPrerequisites:
You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
Vadrik has at least 2 power.
1987-2020-3277.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2020-3277.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

475-549-1274-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-549-1274-3197.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

997-2946-4871-6026.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
997-2946-4871-6026.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

430-2743-6222-6441.easyPrerequisites: You haven't created any tokens this turn.
430-2743-6222-6441.description:
Declare Emissary Green as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to vote for "Profit", creating at least four token copies of Biovisionary due to Esix and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

2173-5220-6505-6634.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

864-4050-7364.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness and another nontoken creature, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Continue? by paying {1}{W}, returning Eternal Witness and at least one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Continue? from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
864-4050-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to two additional creatures each loop to net mana.

375-4522-5346-6891.easyPrerequisites: A permanent you control has a removable quest counter on it.
375-4522-5346-6891.description:
Activate Duchess by paying {1} and removing a quest counter from a permanent you control, creating a Junk token.
When the Junk enters, Hedron Detonator triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Quest for Pure Flame triggers, putting a quest counter on it.
Activate the Junk by tapping and sacrificing it.
Crime Novelist triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Junk's ability, exiling the top card of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5226-6972-7156.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

483-2511-4681-5170.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

147-2171-3967.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard.
147-2171-3967.description:
Cast Persist by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Persist.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Persist, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Persist copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-2921-4359.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

527-1636-5256-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 3 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
527-1636-5256-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
When Sin enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{U} plus an additional {X} equal to Sin's power minus 3.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Selvala.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2919-4186-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-4186-5789.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1808-3000.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2428-3591-5437-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2428-3591-5437-6282.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Repeat.

643-1789-5649-5686.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

413-2486--5.notablePrerequisites:
The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You control your commander.
413-2486--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to your commander's ability granted to it by Master Chef.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

2921-5551-5552.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2921-5551-5552.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3480-5359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-5359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

334-1517-2845-3556.notablePrerequisites: The Mirari Conjecture has exactly two lore counters on it.
334-1517-2845-3556.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on it, and then causing you to copy any instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn and sacrifice The Mirari Conjecture.
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Bloodwater Entity.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the copy of Flicker, blinking Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the original Flicker, blinking Bloodwater Entity.
When Bloodwater Entity enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, putting Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Quintorius Kand's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to exile Flicker from the top of your library and cast it without paying its mana cost, targeting Bloodwater Entity.
Quintorius Kand and The Mirari Conjecture trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius Kand trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the The Mirari Conjecture trigger, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Repeat from step 4.

3518-3605-4393-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Dance of Many from your graveyard by paying {U}{U}.
When Dance of Many enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Muldrotha.
Put the nontoken Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Dance of the Dead from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the token Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Muldrotha token dies, Dance of Many's third ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dance of Many.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may cast any other permanent cards in your graveyard that are not solely enchantments and/or artifacts.

141-2438-5132.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one legendary planeswalker or creature.
141-2438-5132.description:
Cast Primevals' Glorious Rebirth by paying {5}{W}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Primevals' Glorious Rebirth.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the copy of Primevals' Glorious Rebirth, returning all legendary permanent cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-3968-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Grave Titan, adding {C}{C}.
When Grave Titan dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

628-4050-4929.description:
If Cryptic Trilobite has any +1/+1 counters, activate Cryptic Trilobite's first activated ability until it has no +1/+1 counters, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities each time.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cryptic Trilobite, adding {1}.
Cryptic Trilobite's undying ability from Mikaeus triggers, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
